about: Core files allowed to name incompressible physics (gate:h9-no-core-physics). Each entry says why; tools/core_physics_scan.py fails on an entry with no hit.

files.reason: Versioned Project model (project.json): loaded on every project open and save and by the meshers, but no run is written from it (runs are written by the analysis plugin from the study files). PRIMARY_SIM_NAME names the study a project file without studies is given. Moving its physics settings out is proposed (Project model split).

Turbulence types and writers of the versioned Project model: initial_conditions.py and numerics.py import its types to load and migrate old project.json files. Its case-writing functions are called by no run (runs are written by the analysis plugin); removing them belongs to the Project model split.
Versioned Project model (project.json) initial conditions, used when old project files are migrated. No run is written from it.
Versioned Project model (project.json) numerics, used when old project files are migrated and by Project methods. No run is written from it.

Versioned Project model (project.json) settings, loaded on every project open: SolverSettings, BoundarySettings and the TurbulenceModel literal still read old project files. Nothing on the run path reads them. Moving them out is proposed (Project model split).
OpenFOAM install probe (Gate A0 smoke: simpleFoam -help). It checks that the WSL OpenFOAM has its solvers, not physics.
OpenFOAM install probe (simpleFoam -help), the same check as python/cfddesk/wsl/openfoam.py.
LEGACY_PROCESS_NAMES: the process names of runs started before launch specs (v0.2.0 and earlier), so Stop and Force stop still find them.
